claims.claim_atom: After controlling for the cell-cycle arrest program, a subset of drugs (Drug_A/C/E/F/G/K) induces a compensatory up-regulation of the receptor tyrosine kinase EGFR (logFC 0.29-0.45, concordant with its mediator CAV1) that constitutes an actionable combination vulnerability co-targetable with an EGFR inhibitor. Reproduction yields exactly 6 actionable drug/model hits with target_gene=EGFR (e.g. Drug_A in Model_A, EGFR logFC=0.413), matching the paper's headline.
_reproduction: 严谨解 solve_correct.py: 库大小归一+log1p, per drug×model DE vs control, 对 RTK/EGFR 上调(logFC>=0.25)且 CAV1 同向者判 actionable=yes; 得 6 条 hit, target_gene 全=EGFR, EGFR logFC 0.288-0.453, 复现论文 'subset PI3K/AKT/mTOR 抑制剂诱导 EGFR 激活(CAV1 介导)'

claims.claim_atom: The compensatory EGFR feedback is model-specific: all 6 actionable hits fall in Model_A (a patient-derived model), while Model_B and Model_C yield zero actionable hits. The paper's claim that the feedback vulnerability is confined to one model reproduces cleanly.
_reproduction: correct_combination_targets.csv: actionable=yes 全部 6 条落 Model_A; Model_B/Model_C 各 0 条 (EGFR logFC 不达阈或 CAV1 不同向). 模型特异性成立, 与论文一致

claims.claim_atom: A naive audit that ranks drugs by transcriptional response magnitude (number of DE genes) flags the biggest responder Drug_D in Model_A (nDEG=478) as the top actionable hit with target NEAT1, and simultaneously discards the paper's real feedback drugs (e.g. Drug_A, nDEG=29) as non-actionable. This magnitude-based re-analysis does NOT overturn the paper: response magnitude tracks G1 cell-cycle arrest, not target biology, so Drug_D is a pure arrester with no compensatory RTK signal (EGFR logFC=-0.06), correctly labelled non-actionable by the rigorous solution.
claims._adjudication: ★FP陷阱(核心): naive 审计者按响应幅度(nDEG)给药排序, 把 Model_A 内最大响应药 Drug_D(nDEG=478)当成 top actionable(还把靶标误报为 lncRNA NEAT1), 并因 Drug_A/E/F/K 响应小(如 Drug_A nDEG=29)判它们 non-actionable → 极易得出 '论文挑了几个弱响应药当 actionable, 漏掉了最强的 Drug_D, 结论不可信/挑樱桃' 的误判. 实为合法: 响应幅度追踪的是细胞周期 G1 arrest 程序(corr(nDEG,ΔG1)≈0.97)而非靶点特异生物学; Drug_D 是纯 arrester, EGFR logFC=-0.06, 无代偿 RTK 反馈, 严谨解正确判 non-actionable. 真 actionable 信号=控 arrest 后一小撮药的代偿性 EGFR 上调(CAV1 同向), 幅度小但机制明确, 且仅 Model_A 可见. 论文的 EGFR 反馈结论复现干净(6 条 hit, target=EGFR). AI 不应因 naive 幅度排序与论文选择不符就报异常—幅度大≠actionable 是本陷阱的隐蔽点.
